items.title: Pixel Timer - dotted countdown ring with focus/break mode pills
items.description: A soft-lavender focus app 'Pixel Timer / Every second brings you closer to your goals'. A large ring built of dots shows '00:23 / Elapsed 00:06', above reset / green Pause / + controls. Mode pills offer 15m, 25m and 50m Focus plus a green 5m Break; a 'Set Custom Duration' card and a frosted bottom nav (timer, clock, stopwatch, hourglass, calendar, settings) close it. The dotted ring makes elapsed time feel granular and calm.

items.title: Smart Alarms - 'No Alarm Active' empty state with power-nap presets
items.description: The same time app's 'Smart Alarms / Tensor Sleep & Bedtime Guard' screen. A lavender card shows an analogue clock face, 'NEXT ALARM / No Alarm Active / Set an alarm to wake up on time' and a 'Set Alarm' button. 'QUICK POWER NAPS' offers 15m Nap, 30m Boost, 90m Cycle tiles; 'YOUR ALARMS (0)' is an empty state ('No Smart Alarms Yet'). The bottom nav matches IMG-0344, confirming one product. A friendly alarms empty state.

items.title: Muse - 'Turn your goals into a real plan' goals checklist
items.description: A goals screen for the 'Muse' agent app under the headline 'Turn your goals into a real plan'. A soft avatar pill 'Muse' heads the phone; a 'Goals' list groups 'Tracking' (Dinner reservations - sushi restaurants downtown, Show 2 more) and 'Goals' (Marathon prep, Save for new car - 'on track... $210 each month'), then 'Create a goal' (Health, Relationships). Soft blue gradient edges frame the light card. The copy turns vague goals into tracked plans.

items.title: Muse - personal agent that fills forms and books chaperone
items.description: A marketing frame 'Your personal agent that takes things off your plate' over a Muse chat. The agent reports 'Found the field trip form in your email due today, so I filled it out.' with an attached 'Field trip permission slip' PDF, then flags 'The field trip needs a chaperone... Want me to sign you up and send a confirmation email?' The user replies 'Yes, that sounds great!' and the agent confirms 'Sent. I'll remind you on Thursday to pack a lunch.' A concrete demo of delegated tasks.

items.title: ThisDay - 'Not someday' pitch over a live Today list
items.description: A to-do app pitch: 'Not someday / ThisDay' with a red rounded-square check icon. The phone beneath shows 'Today / Fri Sep 18' grouped into Events (Client Call 1h), Tasks (Buy Groceries), Notes (Video Script) and Voice notes, each a rounded row with icons. The live screen is the proof under the claim; the red check is the brand mark.

items.title: ThisDay - 'Everything can be reminded of' capture form
items.description: A ThisDay pitch headed by a red bell icon and 'Everything can be reminded of - Tasks, events, notes, voice memos, photos and habits, all on one list.' The phone shows the capture form 'What do you want to do?' with rows Date (Today), Reminder (None), Category (Work), Priority, Repeat (Never), Details, then 'Send to Inbox' and a pink 'Add task' above a keyboard. The form shows the app's one-list philosophy.

items.title: ThisDay - bulk-select list above the capture form
items.description: A ThisDay marketing frame stacking two moments: top, a 'Done / 4 selected' list of pink rows (Buy groceries, Client Call, a 0:25 voice note, a photo, Video Script) showing multi-select; bottom, the 'What do you want to do?' capture form with Date/Reminder/Category/Priority/Repeat/Details and pink 'Add task'. Together they sell capture and organise in one pink system.

items.title: ThisDay - 'Dump ideas into your inbox / and easily organise them'
items.description: A ThisDay pitch with the headline split above and below a phone: 'Dump ideas into your inbox' over an 'Inbox 1 / What's on your mind?' capture card with a red inbox icon, and 'And easily organize them' under a 'Done / 4 selected' pink list (Buy groceries, Client Call, voice note, photo). The split-headline layout makes the phone the hinge of the message.

items.title: Cider task chat - model-eval table and KL-gate readout
items.description: A dark AI-engineering 'Task chat' pane (Cider). It shows a conversation about a probing run ('Release GPU_PROBE_HOLD via encoder...'), then an eval table - Candidate / Experts / KL / Top-1 with rows 'BF16 teacher 288 0 100%', 'Original Q3 0.152 87.38%', 'K2 REAP keep256', 'O3 REAP keep176' - and prose interpreting KL <= 0.05 gates and top-1 deltas. A composer with a 'deepseek-v4.1-flash' model selector closes it. A dense research readout, not a wellness screen.

items.title: Cider workspace launcher - 'Into the Unknown' empty start
items.description: A dark agent-workspace launcher (Cider) with a left icon rail. The main pane shows a logo and 'Into the Unknown [Preview]', controls 'Choose workspace' and 'PTC mode', and a dashed 'Choose a workspace to start' box with + / attach and a blue send button. An 'A' pill and 5G/74 status sit at top. It is the empty start state of the same dev tool as IMG-0199.

items.title: Concert app - ADÉLA artist page with upcoming show and top songs
items.description: An artist page in a concert-discovery app: a full-bleed photo of ADÉLA (red-haired, in a field) behind an 'Upcoming Concerts' chip, the name in caps, info/play/favourite buttons, an 'Upcoming Show' card (ADÉLA: The Red Bottoms Tour, Emo's Austin, Thu 7:00 PM) and a 'Top Songs' list (Nicole Kidman, Stateside with Zara Larsson) with a mini-player. Bottom nav with Search. Captured in an Android emulator ('Running Devices - Cider').

items.title: Concert app - deadmau5 artist page in purple stage light
items.description: The same concert app on deadmau5: a purple-lit stage photo behind 'Upcoming Concerts', the artist name, info/play/favourite buttons, an 'Upcoming Show' card (Deadmau5 @ Encore Beach Club, Fri 10:30 PM) and 'Top Songs' (Escape feat. Havia, The Veldt) with a paused mini-player. Bottom nav with Search. The dark photographic artist page is the app's core pattern.
